_readme: Voices for generate_audio.py. Reference recordings live OUTSIDE this public repo, in ~/claude/pumpkin-voices on tinkerbox. Add a friend with prep_voice.py, then add an entry here. 'gain' is a pre-normalisation multiplier the older refs needed because they were recorded at different levels; refs made by prep_voice.py are level-matched and use 1.0. 'instruct' steers pitch/age/gender and should describe the real speaker.
